g.text: The null keeps every descriptor's size and every lipid's number of descriptors; which lipids co-occur in a descriptor,

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: and hence pairwise overlaps, are randomized. Circles and squares mark two lipid classes.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: Lower is better. CCLE rungs: reaction neighbours (biochemical), correlation-selected panel of the same size (compact),

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: all other metabolites (full panel). Matched nulls are expected values over 20 realizations.
